title: Nouns Kart 3D
tagline: Nouns Kart 3D is where players put their $APE coins and NFTs to compete in high-stakes races with a twist where the loser surrenders their NFT to the winner.
description: Noun Kart 3D is an intense web3 game where players must stake either their $APE coins or their Noun NFTs derivatives. With each race limited to 5 players, the stakes are high as competitors battle for victory. Enhance your Noun NFT racers, strategically use APECoins for in game item power-ups, and navigate through dynamic tracks to claim the ultimate prize. But remember, in this thrilling game, the loser must surrender their staked NFT to the first-place winner, adding an exhilarating twist to the race. Are you ready to risk it all for glory in Nouns Kart 3D?
how_its_made:
- ApeCoin as an in-game currency for players to put at stake. 
- Solidity: Smart contract for escrow of $APE Coin
- Metamask: Reads and verified the user qualifies for the game and can put NFT’s and coins up for stake. 
- Unity: For creating the game demo
- Meta Spark Studios: For creating the 3D AR demo video.
- Photoshop: Fro touching up textures and materials.
- NOUNS: Used 3D Models of Nouns for the in game characters
- 3D Nouns Generator: Used to make in-game unity assets
- 3D Scanning: Used photogrammetry and 3D processing to render real world objects into 3D assets for in-game use.
